issue_summary: Project setup and CI/CD
Seed script with demo stores, users, busy periods and shifts
As a staff member, I want to sign in and out, so that only I can act under my account
As an admin, I want each role limited to its own actions and store, so that nobody changes another store's data
As an admin, I want to set up stores with their manager and define busy periods, so that stores can post shifts for them
[Merged into HH-13] Define busy periods
As a store manager, I want to post a shift with date, time, task and slots, so that volunteers know what help we need
As a volunteer, I want to filter open shifts by date, busy period, store and task, so that I find one that suits me
As a volunteer, I want to sign up for a shift, so that the manager knows I can help
As a store manager, I want sign-ups refused when the shift is full, too close, clashes or goes over the weekly limit, so that I only get valid requests
CD: deploy main to a test environment after CI passes
User access and store setup
As an admin, I want to manage users, roles and the volunteering rules, so that the right people have access and volunteering stays fair
[Merged into HH-20] Set the weekly limit, notice and cutoff
As a store manager, I want to edit or cancel a shift, so that volunteers are told when plans change
[Merged into HH-18] Weekly hour limit
As a store manager, I want to approve or decline sign-ups without ever overbooking, with the shift showing Filled or Open automatically, so that I get exactly the help I asked for
[Merged into HH-24] Shift shows Filled or Open automatically
As a volunteer, I want to see my schedule and withdraw before the cutoff, so that I can plan my week and free my slot for someone else
As a user, I want in-app notifications for sign-ups, approvals and cancellations, so that I don't miss changes
As a volunteer, I want a reminder 24 hours before my shift, so that I don't forget
[Merged into HH-26] My Schedule
Help requests
As a store manager, I want to mark attended or no-show with hours, so that contributions are recorded
[Merged into HH-32] Coverage view per busy period
As a store manager or admin, I want a coverage view and volunteer reports with CSV export, so that gaps are spotted early and volunteers get recognised
As an admin, I want an audit history of every change, so that decisions can be traced
